question: Before 2020, how could a small unarranged overdraft at a British bank compare with a payday loan?
answer: It could cost more than ten times as much. Banks charged flat daily and monthly fees for going past a limit, so a small sum borrowed for a few weeks could cost far more than from payday lenders, whose prices had been capped since 2015. The regulator then made banks charge one simple interest rate.
move: Turn every fee into a yearly rate before comparing two kinds of borrowing.
ask: Which small charges on my account would shock me if I saw them as a yearly rate?
reference: Financial Conduct Authority, CP18/42 High-cost Credit Review: Overdrafts consultation paper and policy statement, December 2018
